description: Calling for Investment proposals for economically productive utilization of State-Owned Bungalows
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-01-05 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2024-12-09, decided to appoint an Officials’ Committee to submit recommendations for identification of a suitable methodology for the economically productive utilization of bungalows and related premises used as official residences by the former Ministers as well as underutilized houses and premises owned by the Government. Through the Report submitted by the said Officials' Committee, it has been recommended to utilize the said bungalows for Embassies, International Organizations, Diplomatic purposes, Government and Government Affiliated Institutions as well as High-end Restaurant/Boutique Hotels and for more productive investment projects. Accordingly, it has been planned to provide initially identified 24 bungalows for the implementation of productive utilizations under the Public-Private Partnership (PPP) model for a period of 30 years based on their locations, in a manner that does not create social concerns. The proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development to invite Expressions of Interest from interested investors in order to identify suitable investors for this purpose, was approved by the Cabinet.
